metadata.name: AddNotes
metadata.description: Use this API is to add notes to account or to add memo to transaction.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: MemoType
request_fields.description: Type of Note Example: 1 - Account Level 2 - Transaction Level 3 - Status 4 - Manual Transaction 5 - Card Replacement on Legitimate Address 6 - Card Replacement on Fraudulent Address Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: ClientId
request_fields.description: Client Id Valid Values: 1422245 Format:XXXXX Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: Comment
request_fields.description: Additional Comment can be specified for Logging. Valid values :A-Z, a-z Allowable Values: 369

request_fields.name: MemoReason
request_fields.description: Flag for PreDefined Memo Reasons. Please refer appendix Section : Memo Reason Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: MemoTransactionId
request_fields.description: Transaction ID of  Transaction for which memo needs to be added Example :  147852369 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.
